_description: Stage 5 - QuantStats HTML tearsheet from a strategy equity curve.

inputs._notes: CSV with two columns: date (index) and equity. Defaults to the backtrader replay output. Path is resolved relative to the project directory unless absolute.

benchmark._notes: When use_source=true, the benchmark ticker is read from the main config's baselines.dji_ticker. Set use_source=false and provide a ticker (e.g. '^DJI', '^GSPC', 'SPY') here to override.

output._notes: report_dir is resolved relative to the project directory. Set metrics_csv to null to skip the metrics export.

report.title: A2C Portfolio Allocation - QuantStats Tearsheet
report._notes: strategy_name is the column label QuantStats uses in the report. title is the HTML <title>. risk_free_rate is annualised, used in Sharpe/Sortino calculations.
